description: Bridges commodity_id spelling differences between the two NAMIS sources. The daily report's ids are canonical (it is the live, ongoing source); history_to_daily maps the historical workbook's ids onto them. Only confident same-produce pairs are mapped; ids absent here simply have no counterpart.

deliberately_unmapped.banana-imported: history-only; daily has banana-ripe instead — unclear if same produce, do not guess
deliberately_unmapped.sweet-corn: history 2009-2015, sold per 'each' — unit change makes joining to later corn series invalid
deliberately_unmapped.corn-sweet: history 2025+, per 100's; successor listing, no daily counterpart yet
deliberately_unmapped.corn-green: history 2025+, per 100's; no daily counterpart yet
deliberately_unmapped.ginger-local: history 2025+ split of plain 'ginger'; daily still lists unsplit 'Ginger'
deliberately_unmapped.ginger-imported: history 2025+ split of plain 'ginger'; daily still lists unsplit 'Ginger'
deliberately_unmapped.pimento-l-20lb: new 20lb pack listing, coexists with per-100's pimento — different product
deliberately_unmapped.corn-categorized-as-citrus: NOTE: all corn series carry category 'Citrus' — faithful to the source sheets but botanically wrong; do not trust category for corn
